fails_if: the SOS code-sheet reader drops a blank-code row (as it did before: a labelled blank row was read as raw evidence, or as a period section when it carried a period), reads a labelled blank code as missing, keeps an unlabelled blank as a real empty code, or turns a period-only row or an unheaded note into a member
note: Maintainer decision 2026-10-08: a blank code is a real member when the list documents it with a label (the empty code, as SCB's ["", "Uppgift saknas"]); an unlabelled blank row that still names its member is a missing code, which coding reports as unknown_code_membership, never silently dropped. The allowed twins sit in the same sheet: a period with its variable but no code or label (row 6) still opens a period section, and a note under no header (row 7) stays raw evidence. Expected values are the delivered rows read under that rule.
